text:
jamie_ops: kicking off apac-south3 cluster bootstrap now, will hand off after validation window. starting with nodepool-gpu-canary (2 nodes)
kevin_infra: nodepool-gpu-canary pods CrashLoopBackOff, kubelet logs show mount failure for hugetlb: "failed to mount hugetlbfs at /dev/hugepages: no such file or directory"
lina_sre: also seeing spot-allocator return 0 capacity for region: quotaCheck failed -> GPU_COUNT_LIMIT=0. opened provider support ticket 12345
jamie_ops: weird — billing dashboard showed quota available earlier. can someone grep tfvars for quotas/overrides?
mateo_eng: looked at terraform state: instance_template.apac_gpu.preemptible = true. that explains the preemptions/cost oddities (we intended on-demand). not sure how that slipped in — maybe provider default changed on provider v4.2.0
kevin_infra: deploy-bot: terraform apply failed with: 
```
Error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_P100' exceeded.
```
deploy-bot: automatic rollback triggered: reverting to ami v2026-01-15 and nodepool count back to 0 for gpu-canary
jamie_ops: workaround in-place: pin instance_template.preemptible=false in tfvars, pin provider to v4.1.7, redeploy canary 2/2
lina_sre: added network-policy egress for BGP healthchecks — earlier we had asymmetric routes when MTU was 9000 -> packets were dropped between vpc peers. after setting MTU to 8950 on host-init script route leaks stopped
mateo_eng: added a preflight CI job snippet to validate common gotchas: 
```
# quick preflight checks
check_quota --region=apac-south3 --resource=gpu || exit 1
tfvars_check --ensure instance_template.preemptible==false || exit 2
provider_version_check --lock v4.1.7 || exit 3
```
kevin_infra: observed sudden billing alert: billing-bot reported estimated cost x3 due to fallback to on-demand after spot preemptions. created internal ticket FIN-789
billing-bot: :warning: Cost alert: apac-south3 (provisioning) estimated cost spike = $9.2k/day (3x expected)
jamie_ops: current status: canary recreate in progress, containers should start once hugetlb mount script runs before kubelet. added systemd unit ordering change to cloud-init to ensure /dev/hugepages exists before kubelet starts
lina_sre: runbook update suggestion: when bringing up new GPU region, validate in order: 1) GPU quota via cloud API 2) instanceTemplate preemptible flag 3) provider version locked 4) AMI/kernel driver match 5) MTU/network-policy smoke tests 6) cost watch hook to billing channel
mateo_eng: log excerpt for the terraform failure: 
```
google_compute_instance: quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 987654321
```
jamie_ops: canary stabilized at 2 nodes, pods running. applying 10-node pool staged rollout. will watch preemption & costs for 30m then handoff to oncall
kevin_infra: note: if quota check returns zero, tag the support ticket with `infra:quota-requested` and ping sales for priority escalation (we've done this once, helps speed approval)
lina_sre: postmortem starter: root cause = provider version bump changed default for instance_template.preemptible + missing pre-deploy quota validation + cloud-init ordering race for hugetlb. remediation: add preflight CI checks, provider version pin in module, add systemd ordering fix, add billing-alert suppression during expected spot-to-on-demand fallbacks
jamie_ops: handing off to oncall @lina_sre for 2h monitoring and cost watch. leaving notes in runbook under /runbooks/regions/apac-south3/bringup.md :thumbsup:
